_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - NOT configs/finalists.json. Committing configs/finalists.json (same schema) is the PI's G4 act (DESIGN §4/§9): the guard releases test / set-A / set-B targets only to config_hash values listed in a COMMITTED configs/finalists.json. scripts/evaluate_test.py and scripts/evaluate_transfer.py read: headline, T, H3_noEC and baselines.B0/B1/B2, each with name, config (path), config_hash (sha256 of json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True), scripts/run.py) and optional cv_run_id (the clean freeze-eval CV run, used for reproduction checks). At most 2 finalists beyond the headline plus baselines (DESIGN §4): here T and H3_noEC.

headline.name: m1_E_resB0
headline.note: current best (D17/D20a); the PI names the headline after M5 (G3 close-out)

T.name: t_E_status
T.note: transfer model T: E + TP53/RB1 status flags, no lineage (DESIGN §5)

H3_noEC.name: t_E_status_noEC
H3_noEC.note: H3 no-EC variant: T trained without the 4 EC dev lines (D20d erratum)
